similar_in_english: Passed away to the arms of God
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার বাবা আল্লাকা পেয়ারা হো গয়া।
সেই যোদ্ধা যুদ্ধক্ষেত্রে আল্লাকা পেয়ারা হো গয়া।
example_sentences_in_english: His father has become dear to Allah.
That warrior became dear to Allah on the battlefield.
history: This idiom draws from Islamic beliefs where the deceased are considered beloved by Allah, often used in Bengali Muslim communities to softly express death.
note: The idiom shows Urdu/Islamic influence in Bengali linguistic expressions.
